title: Design Thinking for a Joyful Life
approval: Teaching outlines unlocked by the program owner on 2026-10-23

modules.title: Critical Thinking and Information Navigation
modules.outline:
**Core question:** Who or what have I authorized to shape my reality?

### Concepts
- Information glut
- Fact vs argument
- Persuasion filter
- Intentional authority
- Curiosity with skepticism
- Opportunity noticing

### Student outputs
- Fact vs argument sort
- Authority audit
- Media/input inventory
- Persuasion filter reflection

modules.title: Life Design Lab
modules.outline:
**Core question:** What parts of my life are designable, and what parts are gravity?

### Concepts
- Design thinking
- Curiosity
- Reframing
- Radical collaboration
- Bias to action
- Gravity problems
- Work View and Life View

### Student outputs
- Work View reflection
- Life View reflection
- Gravity problem sort
- Reframe map

modules.title: Odyssey Planning and Prototyping
modules.outline:
**Core question:** What are three lives I could build from here?

### Concepts
- Three parallel futures
- Current path improved
- Pivot path
- Wild-card path
- Prototype conversations
- Prototype experiences
- Narrative resonance

### Student outputs
- Three futures worksheet
- Prototype conversation plan
- Prototype experience plan
- Alignment scorecard

modules.title: Mechanics of High-Speed Change
modules.outline:
**Core question:** How do I start before my brain talks me out of starting?

### Concepts
- Activation energy
- 5-second start
- Two-minute entry
- 20-hour skill sprint
- Frustration barrier
- Self-correction

### Student outputs
- Five-second action log
- Skill sprint plan
- Practice barrier removal sheet
- Frustration reflection

modules.title: Environmental Architecture and Resilience
modules.outline:
**Core question:** What around me is shaping who I become?

### Concepts
- Environment over willpower
- Peer group audit
- Media diet
- Input streams
- Support anchors
- Midwives to dreams

### Student outputs
- Environment audit
- Peer group map
- Media cleanup plan
- Support anchor plan

modules.title: Decision Architecture
modules.outline:
**Core question:** How do I choose without getting trapped in endless options?

### Concepts
- Choice overload
- Rule of five
- Gut check after choice
- Commitment after prototyping
- FOMO reduction
- Decision log

### Student outputs
- Choice narrowing sheet
- Top five options
- Decision commitment plan
- Post-choice reflection
